title: What If Every Bird on Earth Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every bird on Earth vanished tomorrow? The silence is the least of the problems.
Birds eat an estimated four hundred to five hundred million tonnes of insects and other arthropods every year.
Without that pest control, crop-eating insects would be much harder to hold back.
Birds also spread seeds. In New Zealand, they disperse the seeds of seventy percent of forest plants.
Vultures clear carcasses within an hour. When India's vultures collapsed, feral dogs rose by about five and a half million.
Lose the birds, and the quiet would be the smallest change.
